name: Ray of Fear (Recharge 4-6)
description: The creature’s eye emits an invisible, magical ray that targets one creature the creature can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the creature until the start of the creature’s next turn.
